response.content:
## Companies Launched in France in 2026

France has seen significant startup activity in 2026 across many sectors. Here is an overview based on available data:

### Startup Formation by Sector (companies founded in 2026 in France)

| Sector | New startups in 2026 |
|---|---|
| IT Services | 301 |
| Retail | 102 |
| Nonprofits | 93 |
| HealthTech | 85 |
| Education | 62 |
| MarketingTech | 64 |
| Auto | 46 |
| Healthcare IT | 36 |
| Cybersecurity | 22 |
| Gaming | 14 |
| Retailers | 12 |
| IT Operations | 7 |
| Payments | 6 |
| AdTech | 3–5 |
| Web 3.0 | 4 |
| Telecom | 3 |
| Telemedicine | 3 |
| Semiconductors | 1 |

IT Services leads with 301 new startups — the highest number in the last 10 years for that sector.

### Notable Companies and Developments in 2026

- **Enodia Therapeutics** — A biotech startup built by Argobio Studio, based on research from the Institut Pasteur. It develops small-molecule therapies for targeted protein degradation. Enodia raised a US$25 million seed round in January 2026 (co-led by Elaia, Pfizer Ventures, and Bpifrance) and announced a research collaboration with Pfizer in October 2026.

- **NGPES** — A French fintech that raised €5 million to build infrastructure linking traditional payment systems with digital asset settlement.

- **Easy-SEO.Agency** — A digital marketing firm founded in 2026, specializing in SEO, content writing, and conversion optimization.

- **Mayéjem** — A corporate training and coaching company founded in 2026.

- **Indy QA** — An AI-operated quality assurance service launched in 2026, run by a single AI agent with no human QA team.

### Broader Ecosystem Context

- France has **53 unicorns** as of November 2026, worth a combined $308.8 billion (including Airbus, Mistral AI, and Neoen).
- The French HealthTech ecosystem includes nearly 2,800 companies, with about a third less than 5 years old. Several French biotechs attracted major funding in 2026, including Abivax (US$920M public offering), Nanobiotix (US$114.4M), Bionyra Pharma (US$165M Series A), and Cyllene Therapeutics (€33M Series A).
- Active French tech funding rounds in late 2026 included Flying Whale (€90M), Spiko (€77.4M), and Resilience Care (€48M).

A comprehensive list of every individual company launched in France in 2026 is not available in a single source, but the data above gives a broad picture of the vibrant startup landscape across sectors.
